#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deterministic, non-timing stdlib controls for one Rust VM experiment."""

from __future__ import annotations

import collections
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import platform
import random
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path("/home/dev-user/src/rebar")
OUTPUT = ROOT / "candidates/evidence/rust-v8-rust-mandatory-prefix-filter-focused-controls.json"
SEED = 2026072317
APIS = (
    "search",
    "match",
    "fullmatch",
    "findall",
    "finditer",
    "scanner-search-match",
    "scanner-match-search",
)


def encode(value):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, int, str)):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        return {"type": "bytes", "hex": value.hex()}
    if isinstance(value, bytearray):
        return {"type": "bytearray", "hex": value.hex()}
    if isinstance(value, memoryview):
        return {"type": "memoryview", "hex": bytes(value).hex()}
    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
        return [encode(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(key): encode(item) for key, item in sorted(value.items())}
    raise TypeError(f"unsupported observation: {type(value).__name__}")


def match_snapshot(match):
    if match is None:
        return None
    template = b"<\\g<0>>" if isinstance(match.re.pattern, bytes) else r"<\g<0>>"
    return {
        "span": encode(match.span()),
        "groups": encode(match.groups()),
        "groupdict": encode(match.groupdict()),
        "regs": encode(match.regs),
        "lastindex": match.lastindex,
        "lastgroup": match.lastgroup,
        "pos": match.pos,
        "endpos": match.endpos,
        "expanded_group_zero": encode(match.expand(template)),
    }


def invoke(module, fixture, pos, endpos, api):
    try:
        compiled = module.compile(fixture["pattern"], fixture["flags"])
        subject = fixture["subject"]
        if api in {"search", "match", "fullmatch"}:
            value = match_snapshot(getattr(compiled, api)(subject, pos, endpos))
        elif api == "findall":
            value = encode(compiled.findall(subject, pos, endpos))
        elif api == "finditer":
            value = [
                match_snapshot(item)
                for item in compiled.finditer(subject, pos, endpos)
            ]
        else:
            scanner = compiled.scanner(subject, pos, endpos)
            sequence = (
                ("search", "match", "search", "match", "search")
                if api == "scanner-search-match"
                else ("match", "search", "match", "search", "match")
            )
            value = [match_snapshot(getattr(scanner, name)()) for name in sequence]
        return {"status": "ok", "value": value}
    except Exception as error:
        return {
            "status": "error",
            "type": type(error).__name__,
            "message": str(error),
            "args": encode(error.args),
            "regex_message": getattr(error, "msg", None),
            "regex_position": getattr(error, "pos", None),
        }


def fixed_fixtures():
    canonical = r"(?P<left>[A-Za-z_]+)-(?P<num>[0-9]+)(?:\.(?P<tail>[A-Za-z]+))?"
    rows = [
        ("calibration-shaped-impossible-miss", canonical, "prefix grove_7-591.native suffix", 0),
        ("calibration-shaped-impossible-miss", canonical, "prefix harbor_8-632 suffix", 0),
        ("calibration-shaped-impossible-miss", canonical, "prefix acorn_2-664 suffix", 0),
        ("calibration-shaped-impossible-miss", canonical, "prefix elm_4-738 suffix", 0),
        ("matching-delimiter-and-captures", canonical, "prefix grove-591.native suffix", 0),
        ("matching-delimiter-and-captures", canonical, "harbor-632", 0),
        ("later-valid-delimiter", canonical, "grove_7-591 then harbor-632", 0),
        ("many-invalid-delimiters", canonical, "x0-1 y2-3 z4-5 valid-9", 0),
        ("minimum-two-all-atoms", r"(?P<head>[ab]{2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "a:7 then ab:42", 0),
        ("minimum-two-all-atoms", r"(?P<head>[ab]{2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "x:1 a:2 b:3", 0),
        ("minimum-three-all-atoms", r"(?P<head>[ab]{3,5}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "ab:1 aba:22", 0),
        ("minimum-three-all-atoms", r"(?P<head>[ab]{3,5}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "a:1 ab:2", 0),
        ("greedy-positive-run", r"(?P<head>[ab]+):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "a:1 ab:22", 0),
        ("lazy-positive-run", r"(?P<head>[ab]+?):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "a:1 ab:22", 0),
        ("possessive-positive-run", r"(?P<head>[ab]++):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "a:1 ab:22", 0),
        ("capturing-repeated-atom", r"((a)){2,4}:([0-9]+)", "a:1 aa:22", 0),
        ("scoped-run-ignorecase", r"(?P<head>(?i:[a-z]){2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "aB:42", 0),
        ("scoped-run-ignorecase", r"(?P<head>(?i:[a-z]){2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "a7:42", 0),
        ("case-insensitive-delimiter-bypass", r"(?P<head>[a-z]+)(?i:X)(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "abx42", 0),
        ("case-insensitive-delimiter-bypass", r"(?P<head>[a-z]+)(?i:X)(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "abX42", 0),
        ("global-ignorecase-safe-bypass", r"(?P<head>[a-z]+)X(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "ABx42", int(re.IGNORECASE)),
        ("zero-minimum-bypass", r"(?P<head>[ab]*):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", ":42", 0),
        ("zero-minimum-bypass", r"(?P<head>[ab]*?):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", ":42 ab:7", 0),
        ("alternation-bypass", r"(?:[ab]+:|q+)(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "qq42", 0),
        ("alternation-bypass", r"(?:[ab]+:|q+)(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "ab:42", 0),
        ("lookahead-bypass", r"(?=[ab])[ab]+:(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "ab:42", 0),
        ("leading-lookbehind-bypass", r"(?<=x)[ab]+:(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "xab:42", 0),
        ("absolute-anchor-bypass", r"^[ab]+:(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "ab:42 xx", 0),
        ("line-anchor-bypass", r"^[ab]+:(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "xx\nab:42", int(re.MULTILINE)),
        ("one-byte-unicode", r"(?P<head>[\u00e0-\u00ff]{2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "éé:42", 0),
        ("one-byte-unicode", r"(?P<head>[\u00e0-\u00ff]{2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "é7:42", 0),
        ("two-byte-unicode-bypass", canonical, "Ā prefix grove-591.native Ω", 0),
        ("two-byte-unicode-bypass", canonical, "Ā prefix grove_7-591 Ω", 0),
        ("four-byte-unicode-bypass", canonical, "😀 prefix grove-591.native suffix", 0),
        ("four-byte-unicode-bypass", canonical, "😀 prefix grove_7-591 suffix", 0),
        ("non-byte-delimiter-bypass", r"(?P<head>a{2,4})Ā(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "aaĀ42", 0),
        ("unicode-category-exact-atoms", r"(?P<head>\w{2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "éé:42", 0),
        ("unicode-category-exact-atoms", r"(?P<head>\w{2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", "é :42", 0),
        ("inverted-and-empty-window", canonical, "ab-42", 0),
        ("delimiter-at-window-boundary", canonical, "prefix abc-42 suffix", 0),
        ("byte-exact-match", rb"(?P<head>[a-z]{2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", b"a:7 then ab:42", 0),
        ("byte-exact-miss", rb"(?P<head>[a-z]{2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", b"a:7 2:9", 0),
        ("byte-high-delimiter", rb"(?P<head>[a-z]{2,4})\x80(?P<num>[0-9]+)", b"a\x801 ab\x8042", 0),
        ("byte-high-delimiter", rb"(?P<head>[a-z]{2,4})\x80(?P<num>[0-9]+)", b"a\x801 7\x802", 0),
        ("byte-high-atoms", rb"(?P<head>[\x80-\xfe]{2,4})\xff(?P<num>[0-9]+)", b"\x80\xff1 \x80\x81\xff42", 0),
        ("byte-high-atoms", rb"(?P<head>[\x80-\xfe]{2,4})\xff(?P<num>[0-9]+)", b"\x80\xff1 7\xff2", 0),
        ("byte-scoped-ignorecase", rb"(?P<head>(?i:[a-z]){2,4}):(?P<num>[0-9]+)", b"aB:42", 0),
        ("byte-case-delimiter-bypass", rb"(?P<head>[a-z]+)(?i:X)(?P<num>[0-9]+)", b"abx42", 0),
    ]
    result = []
    for number, (category, pattern, subject, flags) in enumerate(rows):
        result.append({"id": f"fixed-{number:03d}", "category": category, "pattern": pattern, "subject": subject, "flags": flags})
        if isinstance(subject, bytes):
            for label, converted in (("bytearray", bytearray(subject)), ("memoryview", memoryview(subject))):
                result.append({"id": f"fixed-{number:03d}-{label}", "category": f"{category}-{label}", "pattern": pattern, "subject": converted, "flags": flags})
    return result


def seeded_fixtures():
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    atoms = ("[ab]", "[A-Za-z_]", r"\d", r"\w", ".", "(?:a|b)", "(?i:[a-z])")
    delimiters = ((":", ":"), ("-", "-"), ("|", r"\|"), ("X", "X"))
    alphabet = "abABxyz_017:|-X "
    result = []
    for index in range(384):
        minimum = rng.randrange(1, 6)
        maximum = minimum + rng.randrange(4)
        quantifier = f"{{{minimum},{maximum}}}" + rng.choice(("", "?", "+"))
        delimiter, escaped = rng.choice(delimiters)
        atom = rng.choice(atoms)
        pattern = f"(?P<head>{atom}{quantifier}){escaped}(?P<num>[0-9]{{1,3}})"
        text = "".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randrange(0, 27)))
        if index % 3 == 0:
            text += " " + "a" * minimum + delimiter + str(rng.randrange(1, 100))
        if index % 11 == 0:
            text = "Ā" + text
        if index % 17 == 0:
            text = "😀" + text
        flags = rng.choice((0, int(re.ASCII), int(re.IGNORECASE), int(re.ASCII | re.IGNORECASE)))
        if index % 4 == 1:
            pattern = pattern.encode("ascii")
            text = text.encode("ascii", "ignore")
            if index % 12 == 1:
                text = bytearray(text)
            elif index % 12 == 5:
                text = memoryview(text)
        result.append({"id": f"seeded-{index:03d}", "category": "seeded-exact-mandatory-prefix", "pattern": pattern, "subject": text, "flags": flags})
    return result


def windows(length):
    candidates = (
        (0, length),
        (0, 0),
        (0, max(0, length - 1)),
        (min(1, length), length),
        (length, length),
        (length + 1, length),
        (length + 3, length + 2),
        (min(2, length), min(1, length)),
        (-3, length),
        (0, length + 3),
    )
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(candidates))


def digest(path):
    with path.open("rb") as source:
        return hashlib.file_digest(source, "sha256").hexdigest()


def main():
    if platform.python_implementation() != "CPython" or tuple(sys.version_info[:3]) != (3, 14, 6):
        raise SystemExit("requires pinned CPython 3.14.6")
    if OUTPUT.exists() or OUTPUT.is_symlink():
        raise SystemExit("refusing to overwrite mandatory-prefix evidence")
    if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
    candidate = importlib.import_module("candidates.rust_candidate")
    fixtures = fixed_fixtures() + seeded_fixtures()
    counts = collections.Counter()
    self_failures = []
    failures = []
    expected_digest = hashlib.sha256()
    actual_digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for fixture in fixtures:
        for pos, endpos in windows(len(fixture["subject"])):
            for api in APIS:
                expected = invoke(re, fixture, pos, endpos, api)
                repeated = invoke(re, fixture, pos, endpos, api)
                actual = invoke(candidate, fixture, pos, endpos, api)
                label = {
                    "id": fixture["id"],
                    "category": fixture["category"],
                    "api": api,
                    "pos": pos,
                    "endpos": endpos,
                }
                expected_digest.update(json.dumps([label, expected], ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii"))
                actual_digest.update(json.dumps([label, actual], ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii"))
                counts[fixture["category"]] += 1
                if repeated != expected:
                    self_failures.append({**label, "expected": expected, "repeat": repeated})
                if actual != expected:
                    failures.append({**label, "expected": expected, "actual": actual})
    source = Path(__file__)
    report = {
        "schema": "rebar-rust-v8-mandatory-prefix-filter-focused-controls-v1",
        "candidate": "candidates.rust_candidate",
        "oracle": "pinned CPython standard-library re",
        "python": platform.python_version(),
        "python_executable": sys.executable,
        "seed": SEED,
        "suite_source": source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        "suite_source_sha256": digest(source),
        "fixtures": [{"id": row["id"], "category": row["category"], "pattern": encode(row["pattern"]), "subject": encode(row["subject"]), "flags": row["flags"], "windows": encode(windows(len(row["subject"]))) } for row in fixtures],
        "fixture_count": len(fixtures),
        "apis": list(APIS),
        "correctness_checks": sum(counts.values()),
        "category_counts": dict(sorted(counts.items())),
        "reference_sha256": expected_digest.hexdigest(),
        "candidate_sha256": actual_digest.hexdigest(),
        "self_oracle_failures": self_failures,
        "failed": len(failures),
        "failures": failures,
        "artifacts": {
            "rust_engine_source": {"path": "candidates/rust/src/lib.rs", "sha256": digest(ROOT / "candidates/rust/src/lib.rs")},
            "unchanged_bridge_source": {"path": "candidates/rust/py_bridge.c", "sha256": digest(ROOT / "candidates/rust/py_bridge.c")},
            "rust_engine": {"path": "candidates/_rust_engine.so", "sha256": digest(ROOT / "candidates/_rust_engine.so")},
        },
        "performance": "NOT MEASURED",
        "holdout": "NOT ACCESSED",
    }
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({key: report[key] for key in ("schema", "candidate", "python", "seed", "fixture_count", "correctness_checks", "category_counts", "reference_sha256", "candidate_sha256", "failed", "performance", "holdout")} | {"self_oracle_failures": len(self_failures), "output": str(OUTPUT)}, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
    return int(bool(failures or self_failures))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
